diagnosis: On initial zero-force frames, old adaptive controller replaced requested opening target with lagging measured joint position, which could move the command back toward contact. Traces show repeated little-finger contact chatter and no full 0.5s unload.
change: Keep farther-open commanded/measured position, add0.02rad clearance on newly free frames, continue monotonic target increments on contact. Same actuator bounds/delta/lead, release duration, 120Hz force threshold and stability gates.
validation: Matched A/B integration running; no claim of success until completion.
